models.name: todo_users
models.description: Authenticated user accounts who can login and manage their personal todo items. Includes credentials and audit information. Uniquely identified by UUID. Soft deletable for account deactivation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address for authentication and contact.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to mark user deactivation.

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description: Sessions for authenticated users maintaining JWTs for access control and expiration. Each session references an existing user and records connection context like IP and referrer.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the session client.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL of the session request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or ends.

models.name: todo_todo_items
models.description: Todo items entity storing user tasks with ownership and task details including description, status, due date, and timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion. Each todo is owned by a unique user identified by todo_users.id. This table supports independent CRUD operations for todo items managed by authenticated users.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Text description of the todo item, mandatory, max 255 characters.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the todo item, either 'pending' or 'completed'.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for task completion; if provided must not be in the past.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft deleted; null means active.
